Some high-credibility sources report a small but reliable association between violent video game use and increased aggression and decreased prosocial behavior [d1][d5][d6][d8][d11], while other rigorous studies and meta-analyses find no meaningful or causal link between violent video game play and aggression [d7][d9][d10][d12][d13].
